rationale: The four recorded steps only list and read files, including a manifest still declaring svgo 2.4.0; no upgrade edit or install command is observed. The verifier separately auto-installs Jest 30 and rejects its obsolete CLI option, so it never tests SVG behavior and does not demonstrate an unsuccessful agent installation strategy. The observed lack of an effective upgrade is better supported than install-build-failure, although the unavailable final diff limits confidence.

evidence.quote: npm warn exec The following package was not found and will be installed: jest@30.4.2
